partners.diseaseBName: congenital plasminogen activator inhibitor type 1 deficiency
partners.mechanism_chain: F7 (HGNC:3757) —DISRUPTS→ coagulation cascade (REACT:R-HSA-449049); coagulation cascade (REACT:R-HSA-449049) —LEADS_TO→ Bleeding tendency (HP:0001892); SERPINE1 (HGNC:10564) —DISRUPTS→ fibrinolysis (REACT:R-HSA-169877); fibrinolysis (REACT:R-HSA-169877) —LEADS_TO→ Bleeding tendency (HP:0001892). Loss-of-function mutations in F7 impair the initiation of the coagulation cascade, leading to bleeding. Similarly, loss-of-function mutations in SERPINE1 impair fibrinolysis, causing a reduced ability to break down clots and potentially leading to bleeding due to dysregulated hemostasis. Both pathways are critical for maintaining hemostatic balance.

partners.mechanism_chain: TBL1X (HGNC:11640) —DISRUPTS→ Coenzyme Q10 biosynthesis (REACT:R-HSA-70307); Coenzyme Q10 biosynthesis (REACT:R-HSA-70307) —DECREASES→ Ubiquinone (Coenzyme Q10) (CHEBI:15361); Ubiquinone (Coenzyme Q10) (CHEBI:15361) —DECREASES→ Factor VII activity (HP:0001905); Factor VII activity (HP:0001905) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital factor VII deficiency (HP:0001905); Ubiquinone (Coenzyme Q10) (CHEBI:15361) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital hypothyroidism, nongoitrous, 8 (HP:0011394); F7 (HGNC:3647) —DISRUPTS→ Factor VII activity (HP:0001905). Loss-of-function mutations in TBL1X disrupt the Coenzyme Q10 biosynthesis pathway, leading to decreased levels of Ubiquinone (Coenzyme Q10). This decrease affects multiple downstream processes, including thyroid hormone synthesis (leading to congenital hypothyroidism, nongoitrous, 8) and potentially impacting the activity or synthesis of coagulation factors, including Factor VII, thus contributing to congenital factor VII deficiency. While F7 is the direct gene for Factor VII deficiency, TBL1X's role in CoQ10 biosynthesis creates a potential indirect link to coagulation factor function and thyroid hormone production.

partners.diseaseBName: Rubinstein-Taybi syndrome due to CREBBP mutations
partners.mechanism_chain: F7 (HGNC:3711) —DISRUPTS→ Coagulation cascade (GO:0007596); Coagulation cascade (GO:0007596) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital factor VII deficiency (MONDO:0009211); CREBBP (HGNC:2420) —DISRUPTS→ Histone acetylation and gene expression regulation (GO:0016569); Histone acetylation and gene expression regulation (GO:0016569) —LEADS_TO→ Rubinstein-Taybi syndrome (MONDO:0008393); CREBBP (HGNC:2420) —BINDS→ Coagulation cascade (GO:0007596).
